'''Dorcha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] in the [[Jundland]] area of Tatooine, selling [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
